description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the uniqueness of language strings and unit IDs in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It defines the UniqueLangStringTest class with methods to check for duplicate values and unit IDs in internationalization language strings.

classes.name: UniqueLangStringTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the uniqueness constraints on language string values and unit IDs within the internationalization module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: testUniqueValue
methods.description: Tests that language string values are unique across the system by querying for duplicates and throws an exception if any are found.

methods.name: testUniqueUnitId
methods.description: Checks for duplicate unit IDs among language strings, excluding certain predefined IDs, and throws an exception if duplicates are detected.
